dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical and gradual geometric narrowing of the lateral margins from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform light-grey median pixel intensity across the visible dorsal plane.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: One distinct, high-contrast white circular mark located on the right cranial-dorsal quadrant and a secondary, less-defined white mark on the left caudal-dorsal quadrant.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A single, clear longitudinal indentation or linear crease aligned with the central dorsal axis in the posterior half of the visible body.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple localized white depigmentation marks and a distinct longitudinal mark along the lower dorsal midline.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly visible, high-contrast dark circular aperture at the cranial apex.
